description: This file appears to be a core PHP source file for the SuiteCRM upgrade wizard functionality. It includes functions for handling ZIP extraction, manifest validation, directory management, and UI element retrieval related to the upgrade process.

methods.name: extractFile
methods.description: Extracts a specific file from a ZIP archive into a temporary directory and returns the path to the extracted file.

methods.name: extractManifest
methods.description: Extracts the manifest.php file from a ZIP archive.

methods.name: getInstallType
methods.description: Determines the type of installation (full, langpack, module, patch, theme) based on directory structure in a given string.

methods.name: getImageForType
methods.description: Returns an icon/image URL corresponding to a specific upgrade type, such as full, langpack, module, patch, or theme.

methods.name: getLanguagePackName
methods.description: Loads a language pack file and retrieves its display name from the app_list_strings array.

methods.name: getUITextForType
methods.description: Returns a UI string label for a given upgrade type.

methods.name: getUITextForMode
methods.description: Returns a UI string label for a given mode.

methods.name: validate_manifest
methods.description: Validates a package manifest using the PackageManager class.

methods.name: getDiffFiles
methods.description: Determines modified files between upgrade directories and existing files, used for upgrade diff comparisons.
